cbb.concurrent_vacancy_competition.assessment: Computable but weak. rival_pressure(c) and P(c lost to rival) are two different formulas for one idea (the second multiplies the share by a per-link loss rate h, the first omits h); attract = offer_capacity x prestige double counts resources already in cbb.program_hiring_resources; links come from noisy reports whose reliability is not modelled here (that lives in cbb.coaching_search_report_ledger, which also only exists from own capture start, so h cannot be estimated from past cycles as claimed). No probe covers coaching trackers or USA Today salary data. Point-in-time rule (exclude post-t vacancies/links) is explicit and correct. Not a duplicate of coach_hire_field_residual. Agent verification only.
